# Versions for the CI mirroring (mirror-dryrun.yml, and docs/ci/mirror.yml),
# so that its mirrors are byte-for-byte what the cron on drogon makes.
#
# dandiset.yaml is written by dandi's yaml_dump() with ruamel.yaml's default
# width; ruamel.yaml 0.19 breaks long lines at other places than 0.18 does
# (and leaves a trailing space), so the same metadata comes out differently.
# Drogon has 0.18.  Lift these together with drogon's environment.
ruamel.yaml >= 0.18, < 0.19
dandi == 0.82.0
